title: Python Basics
summary: Master variables, data types, inputs, arithmetic, and type conversion.
skills: Identifies int, float, str, and bool data types
Converts types safely using int(), str(), and float()
Reads user input and prints clean formatted output

title: Decision Maker
summary: Control code execution using if, elif, else, and boolean conditions.
skills: Combines conditions with and, or, and not
Predicts execution flow through nested conditionals

title: Loop Master
summary: Automate repetitive tasks with while and for loops, range, break, and continue.
skills: Writes while loops with guaranteed stop conditions
Traverses sequences and ranges with for loops

title: Pattern Builder
summary: Construct nested loops, star patterns, number triangles, and coordinate grids.
skills: Designs nested loops for rows and columns

title: String Handler
summary: Index, slice, clean, search, and format strings with f-strings and methods.

title: List & Tuple Tamer
summary: Store and organize sequences, understand mutability, slicing, and copies.
skills: Appends, inserts, and removes list items
Distinguishes mutable lists from immutable tuples

title: Dictionary & Set Explorer
summary: Work with fast key-value lookups, hash maps, and unique mathematical sets.
skills: Creates dictionaries and accesses keys safely with .get()
Computes set union, intersection, and difference

title: Function Builder
summary: Write reusable code blocks with def, parameters, return values, and scope.
skills: Defines functions with positional and keyword arguments
Manages local and global variable scope
Breaks large problems into pure functions

title: Error Handler
summary: Prevent crashes using try/except blocks and handle file reading/writing.
skills: Reads and writes text files with with open()

title: Object Builder
summary: Model real-world entities using classes, __init__, self, and inheritance.
skills: Writes instance methods that update state
Builds class hierarchies with single inheritance
